Untrusted content: signo_draft_agent, signo_draft_permission · Private data: signo_draft_agent, signo_draft_permission, wallet_insights_report · Public sink: signo_draft_agent, signo_draft_permission · Destructive: signo_draft_agent, signo_draft_permission.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
